memory_contract.conversion: ceil(ns * MHz / 1000); checked against every actual sample

issue_service_ceiling.basis: one nominal 32-byte transaction per port per implemented issue interval; GB/s uses 10^9 bytes
issue_service_ceiling.limitations: Issue-spacing ceiling only, assuming every port has ready traffic and no credit, queue, response, arbitration or jitter stalls. Reads and writes share this issue budget. Nominal transaction bytes exclude protocol overhead; this is neither measured HBM bandwidth nor effective random-RMW/useful-output throughput, which may require multiple transactions.

resource_observations.aggregation_scope: Counters sum serial sample observations at the same physical endpoint. Peaks are maxima across samples, with the first sample reaching each maximum; they are never summed. FIFO/fork vector indices preserve raw finite.json order. last_retire is a sample-relative cycle, not an additive duration. Stall/occupancy counters may overlap across endpoints/services and are not removable batch wall time.

resource_observations.aggregation_scope: Counters sum serial sample observations at the same physical endpoint. Peaks are maxima across samples, with the first sample reaching each maximum; they are never summed. FIFO/fork vector indices preserve raw finite.json order. last_retire is a sample-relative cycle, not an additive duration. Stall/occupancy counters may overlap across endpoints/services and are not removable batch wall time.

issue_service_ceiling.basis: one nominal 32-byte transaction per port per implemented issue interval; GB/s uses 10^9 bytes
issue_service_ceiling.limitations: Issue-spacing ceiling only, assuming every port has ready traffic and no credit, queue, response, arbitration or jitter stalls. Reads and writes share this issue budget. Nominal transaction bytes exclude protocol overhead; this is neither measured HBM bandwidth nor effective random-RMW/useful-output throughput, which may require multiple transactions.

Stall/occupancy counters may overlap across endpoints/services and are not removable batch wall time.
